verdict.rationale: First-party docs define a skill as a directory with a `SKILL.md` file of YAML frontmatter plus Markdown, optionally with plain scripts, references and assets folders. Anthropic published the format as the Agent Skills open standard, which works across multiple AI tools. A hands-on probe installed an official skill with third-party tooling and read back plain, spec-conformant markdown, and a community developer adapted the repo's skills to run on Gemini. missing for 10: a hands-on demonstration of an unmodified skill running end-to-end in a non-Claude harness (the probe installed into a claude-code target, and the Gemini port required building an adapted model-agnostic version).

support.subject: As a developer, skills are plain markdown files and folders I can read, copy, and carry to another harness — not a proprietary binary format

citations.quote: Skills are simple to create - just a folder with a `SKILL.md` file containing YAML frontmatter and instructions.
The `SKILL.md` file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.

open standard, which works across multiple AI tools.

the repo's skills are plain, spec-conformant markdown folders installable by third-party tooling, no Anthropic account needed
